name: Qara Yuluk Uthman Beg
contribution: A late 14th and early 15th-century leader of the Turkoman tribal federation of Aq Qoyunlu in what is now eastern Turkey, Iran, Azerbaijan and Iraq.
legacy: The transformation of the Aq Qoyunlu tribal confederation into a regional power took place under this person.

checks.lead: Uthman Beg or Osman Beg (Azerbaijani: Qara Yuluq Osman Bəy; Turkish: Kara Yülük Osman Bey; 1356 – 1435) was a late 14th and early 15th-century leader of the Turkoman tribal federation of Aq Qoyunlu in what is now eastern Turkey, Iran, Azerbaijan and Iraq.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
